pose_assumption: World points use the simulator's known exact pose; no SLAM or pose estimation.

semantics.voxel: Stable first observed measured representative; later observations never change its position or intensity.
semantics.step: Scan/control index k; no extra final-state scan. Negative one is empty; indices beyond the last scan hold the final map.

raster.0: Unknown: no measured endpoint in this cell.

semantics.precedence: Elevated-surface evidence takes precedence only from its own first observed step onward; later ground observations do not erase it.
semantics.limits: No rays mark free or traversable space. No unseen interiors or true obstacle coverage are inferred. All measured heights, including above robot body height, are retained unless an explicit z crop is requested.
semantics.area: Observed endpoint cells divided by regular raster ROI cells; this is not traversable area or true surface coverage. For non-grid-aligned crops, the enclosing regular raster extent is recorded separately.
